name: yolo11n_vcsc_proportional_development_v2
purpose: Development-only replacement study after VCSC-v1 rejection. Frozen YOLO11n and train-only calibration construction.

data.official_test_policy: The official positive test, weather splits, official size subsets, and official negatives are locked. This configuration must not evaluate, tune, or select on them.

decision_rule.freeze_if: On the development split, VCSC-proportional has mean mAP50 at least 0.005 above Uniform, does not reduce mAP50-95 or XS/S mAP50, and has no higher mAP50 standard deviation than Uniform by more than 0.005.
decision_rule.otherwise: Do not evaluate the locked official test or scale to 15 models; revise or abandon the proposed policy.
